levels.name: 烬土回春
levels.subtitle: 分裂潮携治疗链苏醒 · 双径灰烬下涌动
levels.subtitle_en: Splitter tides wake with Healer chains · Both lanes stir beneath the ash
levels.story_intro: 烬土回春是决战的起点，灰烬之下分裂潮带着治疗链苏醒，双路一起涌动。蛋蛋知道，真正的决战从这里开始。
levels.story_intro_en: Ashen Rebirth opens the final battle as splitter tides wake with healer chains and both lanes stir. Eggy knows the true showdown starts here.
levels.story_outro: 回春的第一战拿下，决战的旗帜高高升起。
levels.story_outro_en: The first clash of rebirth is won, and battle flags rise high.

levels.name: 孢环滋蔓
levels.subtitle: 召唤与护盾互相滋养 · 滚雪球式增援不断
levels.subtitle_en: Summoners and Shield Generators feed each other · Reinforcements snowball nonstop
levels.story_intro: 孢环滋蔓像野草一样蔓延，召唤怪和护盾发生器互相喂养，援军越滚越大。蛋蛋决定速战速决，不给对面滚雪球的机会。
levels.story_intro_en: Creeping Spore Rings spread like weeds as summoners and shield generators feed each other and reinforcements snowball. Eggy strikes fast to deny any snowball chance.
levels.story_outro: 蔓延的孢环被连根拔起，战场安静了一瞬。
levels.story_outro_en: The spreading rings are uprooted, and the field stills for a moment.

levels.name: 铁壁灰垣
levels.subtitle: 抗性铁壁结阵推进 · 短冲怪撕开缺口
levels.subtitle_en: Resistant ramparts advance in lockstep · Chargers exploit every gap
levels.story_intro: 铁壁灰垒抗性壁垒齐步推进，冲锋怪专找缺口钻。蛋蛋把缺口一个个补上，让铁壁撞上更高的墙。
levels.story_intro_en: Rampart of Ash advances resistant ramparts in lockstep while chargers exploit every gap. Eggy patches each gap so the iron wall hits an even taller wall.
levels.story_outro: 灰垒的推进停下了，防线比开战前更加牢固。
levels.story_outro_en: The rampart advance halts, and the line stands stronger than before.

levels.name: 蚀谷空袭
levels.subtitle: 三径飞行与狂暴齐袭 · 制空不足即溃
levels.subtitle_en: Fliers and Ragers raid all three lanes · Thin anti-air collapses fast
levels.story_intro: 蚀谷空袭三路齐鸣，飞行兵和狂暴怪联手突袭，防空稍薄就会崩盘。蛋蛋把最好的对空塔摆上高台，抬头迎战。
levels.story_intro_en: Scourged Valley Raid rings across three lanes as fliers and ragers raid together and thin anti air collapses fast. Eggy plants the best anti air towers high to meet the sky assault.
levels.story_outro: 空袭被打退了，山谷的天空重新干净起来。
levels.story_outro_en: The air raid is repelled, and valley skies run clear again.

levels.name: 潮鸣烬野
levels.subtitle: 虫潮短冲浪涌叠加分裂 · 中段强度再上台阶
levels.subtitle_en: Swarm and Charger tides stack with Splitters · Mid-chapter intensity steps up again
levels.story_intro: 潮鸣烬野虫群与冲锋潮叠着分裂怪，中场强度再上一个台阶。蛋蛋听着潮声，反而把布阵调得更细。
levels.story_intro_en: Tides over the Ashen Wilds stack swarm and charger tides with splitters as mid chapter intensity steps up again. Eggy listens to the tide and tunes placement even finer.
levels.story_outro: 烬野的潮声小了下去，决战的中场稳稳拿下。
levels.story_outro_en: The wild tide quiets, and the middle of the final battle holds firm.

levels.name: 蔓棘走廊
levels.subtitle: 召唤双径接力护航 · 治疗核心随行回血
levels.subtitle_en: Summoners relay down both lanes with escort · Healer cores mend on the march
levels.story_intro: 蔓棘走廊两条路上召唤怪接力不断，治疗核心边走边修补。蛋蛋算好行进节奏，在拐角处截断修补链。
levels.story_intro_en: Briar Corridor relays summoners down both lanes with escorts while healer cores mend on the march. Eggy reads their marching rhythm and cuts the mending chain at the corner.
levels.story_outro: 走廊的修补链断开了，召唤潮也跟着哑火。
levels.story_outro_en: The corridor mending chain snaps, and the summoner tide fizzles.

levels.name: 三岔会猎
levels.subtitle: 三径全机制会猎 · 分裂治疗与狂暴同台
levels.subtitle_en: Every mechanic hunts across three lanes · Splitters, Healers, and Ragers share the stage
levels.story_intro: 三岔会猎是全机制的围猎，分裂怪、治疗怪和狂暴怪分走三条路。蛋蛋把队伍也分成三支，约定哨声一响就一起开火。
levels.story_intro_en: The Threefork Hunt sends every mechanic hunting across three lanes with splitters, healers, and ragers sharing the field. Eggy splits into three teams to open fire together at the whistle.
levels.story_outro: 会猎的猎物一个没跑掉，三岔路口飘起炊烟。
levels.story_outro_en: No prey escapes the hunt, and cooking smoke rises at the forks.

levels.name: 灰烬兵营
levels.subtitle: 铁壁与双召唤共振 · 双径极限绞杀再临
levels.subtitle_en: Ramparts resonate with twin Summoners · Both lanes squeeze to the limit again
levels.story_intro: 灰烬兵营壁垒与双召唤怪共鸣，两条路再次被挤到极限。蛋蛋回头看看身后的村庄，眼神更加坚定。
levels.story_intro_en: Barracks of Ash resonates ramparts with twin summoners as both lanes squeeze to the limit again. Eggy glances back at the village and steadies his gaze.
levels.story_outro: 兵营的火光熄灭了，通往终点的路就在眼前。
levels.story_outro_en: Barracks fires die out, and the road to the end lies ahead.

levels.name: 风暴余怒
levels.subtitle: 狂暴风暴携重装余怒 · 速度与铁壁并压
levels.subtitle_en: Rager storms carry the waning storm's wrath · Speed and iron armor press together
levels.story_intro: 风暴余怒裹着最后的怒气，速度与铁甲一起压来，狂暴风暴席卷双线。蛋蛋把减速和爆发的顺序排到极致，迎接倒数第二战。
levels.story_intro_en: Wrath of the Waning Storm carries last wrath as speed and iron armor press together in rager storms on both lanes. Eggy perfects the order of slowing and burst to meet the second to last battle.
levels.story_outro: 余怒的风停了，只剩下最后一座庭院。
levels.story_outro_en: The wrathful wind stops, and only one last garden remains.

levels.name: 回春之庭
levels.subtitle: 终幕三王分道压境 · 全机制余烬在此会师
levels.subtitle_en: Grand finale · Three Bosses march separate lanes as every last ember converges
levels.story_intro: 回春之庭是最后的决战，三位首领分走三条路，所有的余烬在此交汇。蛋蛋带着全村的希望走上高台，轻声说，为了明天，今天绝不让路。
levels.story_intro_en: Garden of Rebirth is the grand finale as three Bosses march separate lanes and every last ember converges. Eggy climbs the platform with the hope of the whole village and whispers that today there is no giving way for the sake of tomorrow.
levels.story_outro: 庭院的花开了，蛋蛋村迎来了真正的春天。
levels.story_outro_en: Flowers bloom in the garden, and true spring comes to the village at last.
